% An article with titletoc's partial lists, listings' list, and
% algorithm's list, beside the lists of an earlier build with no .aux: the
% .ptc, .plf, .plt, .lol, and .loa. The earlier build had no entries: each
% list holds only an \addtocontents write of \oldmark, which this document
% does not define, after titletoc's \ttl@starttoc in its own files. The
% .ptc also has a line of text written with \addtocontents, so only its
% extension shows it is a list. The stale files stay as they are.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{titletoc}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{listings}
\usepackage{algorithm}
\begin{document}
\lstlistoflistings
\listofalgorithms
\section{First}
\startcontents
\printcontents{}{1}{}
\startlist{lof}
\printlist{lof}{}{}
\startlist{lot}
\printlist{lot}{}{}
Text of the first section.
\subsection{New subsection}
Text of the subsection.
\begin{figure}[h]
\centering A figure.
\caption{New figure}
\end{figure}
\begin{table}[h]
\centering A table.
\caption{New table}
\end{table}
\begin{lstlisting}[caption={New listing}]
x = 1
\end{lstlisting}
\begin{algorithm}[h]
An algorithm.
\caption{New algorithm}
\end{algorithm}
\end{document}
